turns.replyText:
How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?

For most orders within the contiguous United States, standard carrier transit time is typically about 1–5 business days once your order leaves our nursery.

A couple of helpful details:

At checkout, you’ll see a delivery calendar where you can choose an estimated arrival date that already factors in our processing time plus that 1–5 day transit window.
If you use an express payment method (like Shop Pay or PayPal), the system will skip the calendar and automatically assign an estimated arrival date based on your location and planting season; that date will be listed in your order confirmation email.

If you tell me what you’re planning to order and your state or province, I can give a more tailored idea of timing.

turns.replyText:
What's your return and refund policy?

Hi, happy to clarify.

Our return and refund policy depends on the type of item:

• Gardening tools and hard goods: These can be returned within 30 days of delivery if they are new and unused. Opened or used merchandise is not accepted, except gloves, which may be returned if they’re in their original packaging. Return shipping is the customer’s responsibility.

• Tags and stakes: These are non-returnable because each one is custom engraved to order.

• Fertilizers, soil amendments, beneficial insects, and plant treatments: These are final sale and are not covered by warranty.

• Roses: We do not accept returns on live plants, but roses are covered by a one-year guarantee.

• Perennials: We do not accept returns on live plants, but perennials are covered by a 90-day guarantee.

• Bulbs, tubers, roots, seeds, and corms: These are covered by a failure-to-bloom guarantee.

For the full policy, you can review our guarantee page here: Our Guarantee

If you want, I can also break it down for a specific item you’re considering or already ordered.
